rule: S107 (G-1) — the FULL auto-discover battery's pass count, per sprint, so the generated header's Δ RECONCILES: full === prev + added − removed. V36's header hand-typed Δ+34 (the FILE count) against a real +66 (tests); the numbers are now COMPUTED and cross-checked. `full` is measured at the sprint's close (two identical runs); `added`/`removed` are DERIVED (full − prev / named removals).
note: fullPass is updated at the V37 close to the measured two-run count; added = fullPass − prevFullPass; Consistency.batteryReconciles asserts fullPass === prevFullPass + added − removed.
